rounds.text: Saven Technologies Ltd is profoundly under-appreciated given its exceptional profitability and surging growth metrics trading at a modest P/E of 12.4x [E1] and a price-to-book ratio of just 1.95x [E2]. The company delivers a robust Return on Assets of 10.54%, vastly outperforming the sector benchmark of 5.07% [E8]. This operational strength is translating into acceleration, evidenced by a dramatic 32% compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months [E21] and a recent quarterly operating margin expansion to 23% from 15% in the year-ago quarter [E31]. Furthermore, top-line momentum is exceptional with sales surging 35% YoY [E63], beating the sector median profit growth of 11.2% [E71]. This fundamental outperformance is underscored by a stellar 5-year compounded profit growth of 16% [E19] and a strong dividend yield of 3.86% [E4]. Conceded: operating margin has contracted to 20% in Mar 2026 from 31% three years earlier [E30].
